content.short: SushiBytes are deliciously cute NFT collectables with utility.
content.description:
SushiBytes are deliciously cute NFT collectables with utility. They are generated algorithmically from skillfully hand-drawn 'bits'. The unique bits bring fun, rarity, and LIFE to the SushiBytes.

SushiBytes has released two of the first games on the Cardano blockchain: SushiByte Catch & SushiFights, which can be played with your NFT utility token. Available on desktop or on your mobile device.

Only 10K SushiBytes will ever be minted. They are all special and cute. Some will be more rare than others. A few will be ultra rare (like ninja rare!)
